chunks: Which of the favours of your Lord will you then deny?
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Which of the favours of your Lord will you then deny?' in Surah Ar-Rahman?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this refrain is interpreted as a dual address to humans and jinn, emphasizing the cognitive and spiritual obligation to recognize Allah's favors. The repetition underscores the concept of 'tadbir' (divine management) and serves as a reminder that denial of blessings leads to spiritual loss, a theme central to the narrative of the Day of Judgment.
